public_claim: LineStar describes per-athlete DFS projections as an expected median outcome.
independent_plan: Independent recency-weighted mean of synthetic historical fantasy points. This is not a reconstruction of the vendor model.
limitation: A mean is not a median; no measured accuracy parity.
required_inputs: Point-in-time game outcomes;Sport / operator scoring version

public_claim: LineStar describes a weighted average of industry projections.
independent_plan: Blend only independently built or explicitly licensed forecasts after out-of-sample weight selection.
limitation: Contributors, weights, and reuse rights are not established.

public_claim: The guide describes updates for weather, lineup changes, and news, with sport-specific expert review of anomalous projections.
independent_plan: Fixture quality checks fail closed for stale or invalid data; no automatic human override.
limitation: Autonomous operation cannot silently reproduce the vendor’s expert judgment.

public_claim: Users can replace a player projection.
independent_plan: Version and audit overrides; defaults must not require manual entry.
limitation: Not implemented in the public demo; no UI suggests a user override is a trained model.

public_claim: The guide describes CSV export and import requiring column mapping and outlier-name resolution.
independent_plan: Export our synthetic projections and lineups in a project-specific CSV format.
limitation: Import and operator-compatible upload formats are not implemented. Automatic name matching was overstated in the old repo.

public_claim: The guide documents slate, game, team and position filters and projected points per $1,000 in salary.
independent_plan: Projection lab supports position filtering and sorting by points, value, and salary.
limitation: Salary is synthetic. Value is not expected return.

public_claim: The app listing describes graphs comparing recent performance with projections.
independent_plan: Display a deterministic walk-forward fixture evaluation with timestamps and error metrics.
limitation: Synthetic error metrics test software, not real predictive performance.

public_claim: The guide describes using projections with platform-specific salaries, positions, and contest rules.
independent_plan: Exact small-pool search maximizes summed independent means under the demo roster constraints.
limitation: Demo roster is a project specification, not an audited operator integration. Patents still require counsel.

public_claim: The guide documents locking chosen players and excluding unwanted players.
independent_plan: Library enforces explicit slot locks and excluded IDs; late-swap scenario exercises slot preservation.
limitation: Library controls are tested; the UI presents fixed scenarios rather than every control.

public_claim: The guide advertises sets of 150+ lineups and export to supported operators.
independent_plan: Generate up to three distinct fixture lineups, export project CSV.
limitation: Small-pool prototype is not a 150-lineup production solver or an operator submission tool.

public_claim: The guide describes ranked potential stacks that users can select for optimization.
independent_plan: An optional same-team QB + WR/TE constraint is implemented.
limitation: A stack constraint is not a fitted joint-outcome model or a profit guarantee.

public_claim: The pricing page advertises exposures and budget management.
independent_plan: Library enforces salary limits and requested-set maximum exposure counts, rejecting incomplete portfolios.
limitation: Greedy sequential lineup selection is not a globally optimal portfolio. Exact vendor cap semantics not inspected.

public_claim: The guide separates individual replacement selection from bulk set re-optimization, and says operator entries must also be updated.
independent_plan: Freeze started-game players in their exact slots and exclude newly locked additions.
limitation: No operator submission. Eligibility depends on contest rules and trustworthy lock times.

public_claim: LineStar describes estimating the share of fantasy teams rostering a player using performance, matchups, injuries and salary.
independent_plan: Train on licensed, contest-specific realized ownership with temporal holdouts.
limitation: No ownership numbers are fabricated. Training set and calibration are unknown.

public_claim: The guide describes hindsight salary-and-position-constrained optimal lineups and advertises a free historical view.
independent_plan: Compute a hindsight upper bound from licensed settled results, separately from predictive backtests.
limitation: Do not use the hindsight optimum as an achievable historical strategy.

public_claim: Public navigation lists a DraftKings-versus-FanDuel salary comparison.
independent_plan: Join licensed salaries by canonical ID, accounting for different budgets and scoring.
limitation: A link does not prove cross-platform field quality or access.

public_claim: Public navigation lists daily salary moves.
independent_plan: Compare versioned snapshots within a consistent provider and contest type.
limitation: Do not mix differently scoped slates.

public_claim: Public NFL navigation lists TD scoring trends.
independent_plan: Model touchdown counts / probabilities from role and opportunity data after calibration.
limitation: No extension to college or Canadian football is established.

public_claim: Public NFL navigation lists a snap-count tool.
independent_plan: Derive role shares from licensed participation data with availability timestamps.
limitation: Data publication schedules must be checked, not assumed live.

public_claim: Public NFL navigation lists red-zone usage.
independent_plan: Version a red-zone definition and aggregate plays before the prediction cutoff.
limitation: Definition and exact vendor calculations are not disclosed by a menu label.

public_claim: Public navigation lists matchup breakdowns and defense-versus-position; the guide gives batter/pitcher and receiver/corner examples.
independent_plan: Use regularized, time-safe opponent adjustments and report sample sizes.
limitation: Small head-to-head samples do not establish predictive value.

public_claim: The NBA guide describes changing a player’s minutes and recalculating remaining-player usage; pricing mentions a Court Simulator.
independent_plan: Model team-minute conservation and role redistribution with lineup availability.
limitation: Do not claim the same feature for WNBA or NCAAB.

public_claim: The pricing comparison lists a Daily Dinger Report for MLB home-run predictions.
independent_plan: Build a separately calibrated home-run probability model using authorized pitch and plate-appearance data.
limitation: The advertised result is not evidence of discrimination or calibration.

public_claim: The public NFL menu lists rankings, ADP and draft tools.
independent_plan: Acquire authorized ADP snapshots and define season-long scoring and roster rules.
limitation: The earlier MLB scope and 2025 date were not substantiated.

public_claim: Props AI documentation describes prop-line collection and evaluation with expected-value and outcome-likelihood fields.
independent_plan: Demonstrate unit-stake EV arithmetic from explicitly assumed probabilities and odds.
limitation: No calibrated prop probabilities or real prices; not a Props AI replica.

public_claim: The guide describes 5-game / 10-game / season histories, saved filters and tracking without wagering.
independent_plan: Store authorized historical market snapshots and immutable paper-pick decisions.
limitation: Replaying today’s line over historical games is descriptive, not a valid historical betting backtest.

public_claim: The public menu labels a confirmed-lineups dashboard.
independent_plan: Use licensed confirmation events with provenance and a freshness deadline.
limitation: A roster or depth chart is not a confirmed starting lineup.

public_claim: The public menu lists live contest scoring.
independent_plan: Reconcile authorized live events with versioned scoring and corrections.
limitation: Static Pages has no continuously running feed backend.

public_claim: The public menu describes a what-changed-and-why projection view.
independent_plan: Publish model version, input timestamps and reason codes for every recomputation.
limitation: A menu description does not identify triggers or latency.

public_claim: The navigation lists player news and strategy; pricing describes expert, beat-reporter and team sources.
independent_plan: License news inputs; link to originals rather than republishing reporting.
limitation: No supplier, social-scraping rights, or measured sentiment edge established.

public_claim: The public documentation index describes real-time conversation with DFS players and experts.
independent_plan: A separate moderated discussion feature could be built; no data is copied.
limitation: Not equivalent to FanSense sentiment or expert editorial coverage.

public_claim: The app listing describes a view of how other users feel about an athlete.
independent_plan: Any future sentiment feature must collect first-party consented feedback.
limitation: Community opinions are not ground-truth ownership and cannot be recreated without a community.

public_claim: The app listing advertises weather alerts, contextual icons and critical game/player push notifications.
independent_plan: Generate rule-based alerts from authorized status / weather data; keep delivery separate from the model.
limitation: No response-time guarantee. Native push is not in this static prototype.

public_claim: The feature guide says lineups sync between the same account’s mobile and desktop clients.
independent_plan: The site is responsive; future account-backed state sync requires a backend.
limitation: Responsive design does not implement native apps or cloud synchronization.

public_claim: The old repository asserted exact group-count and bring-back controls; these details were not confirmed in the reviewed evidence.
independent_plan: Treat generic group constraints and opponent bring-backs as our own proposed requirements, not verified vendor features.
limitation: Keep unverified until a permitted primary description supports each control.

public_claim: The guide describes higher-floor cash-game preferences and higher-ceiling tournament preferences.
independent_plan: Evaluate full outcome distributions and contest payouts; do not equate a heuristic score with expected profit.
limitation: The old projection × (1 − ownership) objective had no validation.
